# Annotation Editor {#sec-annotations}

**Purpose.** Record human annotations only where you disagree with the AI suggestions or want to add a finding. The Annotation Editor opens automatically after **Confirm DR Grade**.

AI suggestions are optional visual evidence. You only need to edit a region when you disagree or want to record a human annotation. Confirming annotations completes this case; it does not mean every AI ROI was individually verified. Untouched AI suggestions stay AI suggestions; they never become human labels by themselves.

![Annotation Editor after grade confirmation: canvas, **Finish this image** panel, and optional editor tools.](screenshots/07-annotation-editor.png){#fig-editor width=90%}

If an image is opened here before its grade is confirmed, a warning with **Open Clinician Review** appears and **Confirm Annotation** stays disabled. Your draft is kept.

## Correct or remove an AI ROI

**Steps.**

1. Click an AI ROI on the image (inline or full-screen). It is highlighted, other ROIs dim, and the **AI suggestion** card opens beside it without covering it. Near the edge of the viewer the card moves to the other side or docks in a corner.
2. Read **Model score** and **Model: PRISM-DR**.
3. To change the class, choose it in **Lesion class**. The score line then reads *for AI class ...*: the score belongs to the model's class, not to your correction.
4. To change the box, drag it or drag a handle. The original AI box stays visible underneath.
5. Choose **Confirm** to record the ROI as a human annotation, **Remove** to remove it from the active reviewed result, or **Close** (or Escape) to leave without a change.

**Expected result.** *Annotation confirmed* or *AI suggestion removed* appears briefly and you stay on the image. A corrected ROI is shown as **clinician corrected** without a score. The original AI class, score, geometry, and model identity stay in the review record; a removed suggestion stays in the audit record.

::: {layout="[[50,50]]" layout-valign="top"}
![Selected AI ROI with its card beside it.](screenshots/08-roi-popover.png){#fig-roi}

![After correction: HUMAN annotation, no inherited score.](screenshots/09-roi-corrected.png){#fig-roi-corrected}
:::

::: {.callout-important title="Important -- score meaning"}
A model score belongs to the class and box the model predicted. If PRISM suggests `Hemorrhage · 0.55` and you change the class to Hard exudate, the result is **Hard exudate -- clinician corrected**. It is never shown as `Hard exudate · 0.55`.
:::

## Draw human annotations

Under **Editor tools**, choose **Box**, **Polygon**, **Point**, or **Circle** and a **New annotation class**, then draw. Double-click to finish a polygon. **Select**, **Undo**, **Delete selected**, and **Lock selected** adjust your own annotations. Human annotations are stored in original image pixels and remain separate from the AI evidence. Dense geometry work can use the optional CVAT round trip (@sec-cvat).
